name: Can You Tile Over Existing Tile? When It Works and When It Fails
title-tag: Can You Tile Over Existing Tile? An Installer's Answer
meta-description: Can you tile over tile? Yes, on sound, well-bonded floors in dry rooms. Where it fails: showers, hollow spots, walls, and the half inch of height nobody checks.
post-summary: September 15, 2026 · Tiling over existing tile is a legitimate shortcut on a sound, well-bonded floor in a dry room — and a predictable failure in showers, over hollow spots, and on walls. The deal-breaker almost nobody checks first is height. Here is the checklist we run before we will set new tile over old, and the honest math on what the shortcut actually saves.
